name: Lakshya Jhalani
player_statement:
A complete player, Lakshya Jhalani has made a big mark in cricket. With 23 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 30, with an average of 10.00 and a quick strike rate of 123.08. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 9 sixes and 3 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 19.4 overs, taking 11 wickets at an economy rate of 10.32. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
